targets.query: from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -3h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary" and r._field == "pv_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -3h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grid" and r._field == "einspeisung_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -3h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "grid" and r._field == "bezug_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -3h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary" and r._field == "house_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heizung" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.stelle == "kessel") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Kessel Haupthaus" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heizung" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.stelle == "boiler") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Boiler Haupthaus" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "villa" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.stelle == "kessel") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Kessel Villa" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gartenhaus" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.stelle == "kessel") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Kessel Gartenhaus" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "schwimmbad" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.stelle == "becken") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Schwimmbad" }))
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -3h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "summary" and r._field == "boiler_total_w") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -40m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "temp_c" and (r.name == "vorkuehlraum" or r.name == "milchkuehlraum" or r.name == "fleischkuehlraum")) |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r.name == "vorkuehlraum" then "Vorkühlraum" else if r.name == "milchkuehlraum" then "Milchkühlraum" else "Fleischkühlraum" }))
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -6h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r.name == "aussen" and r._field == "temp_c") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r.name == "aussen" and r._field == "precip_mm") |> difference(nonNegative: true) |> sum() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: r._value * 0.2 }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r.name == "aussen" and r._field == "pressure_hpa") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forecast" and r._field == "pressure_hpa") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
